reconcile.note: Gill reads Stephen's Acts 7 clause as compressing two separate transactions, Abraham's Machpelah purchase and Jacob's later purchase at Shechem, into one summary statement.

discrepancy.note: Isaac of Troki charges Stephen with confusing the two patriarchs' separate purchases, assigning Jacob's Shechem field to Abraham.

quotes.text: Fifthly, the plot of field, situated near Schachem, was purchased by Jacob, and not by Abraham. The author of the Acts had but a confused idea of the several purchases made by the patriarchs Abraham and Jacob, and his statements respecting them must have been from hearsay.
quotes.attr: Isaac ben Abraham Troki (d. 1594), Faith Strengthened (Chizzuk Emunah), trans. Moses Mocatta (1851), ch. LXIII, on Acts 7:16.

sides.snippet: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre,
sides.verseText: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre,

sides.snippet: and they were brought back to Shechem, and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.
